name: Grk Takes Revenge
description: Dive into another thrilling adventure with Tim and his mischievous dog, Grk, in Joshua Doders captivating middlegrade novel, Grk Takes Revenge. As the third installment in the popular Grk series, this exciting story whisks our unlikely duo away to the exotic and challenging landscape of Papua New Guinea, promising a truly unforgettable escapade. No sooner do Tim and Grk arrive than they find themselves entangled in a highstakes mission. They must navigate dense jungles, brave raging rivers, and scale towering mountains to rescue rare birds and innocent prisoners. But the clock is ticking, as they race against time to prevent a very wicked act of revenge from unfolding. Amidst the danger and daring escapades, Grk, with his signature blend of charm and chaos, manages to find trouble at every turn, adding a delightful layer of humour to their perilous journey. Perfect for young readers who love adventure, mystery, and a good laugh, Grk Takes Revenge is a gripping tale of friendship, courage, and unexpected heroism. Fans of the Grk series and new readers alike will be swept away by this actionpacked quest, filled with intrigue and heartwarming moments between a boy and his beloved canine companion.

name: Brain Freeze: World Book Day 2018
description: Dive into a refreshingly funny adventure with Brain Freeze, the special World Book Day 2018 offering from the bestselling author Tom Fletcher. Known for his imaginative and heartwarming stories like The Christmasaurus and The Creakers, Fletcher delivers a brilliant, short read perfect for young bookworms. Illustrated by Shane Devries, this delightful childrens book offers a standalone story brimming with humor and mystery. The story introduces readers to Sam, a curious boy whose town is plagued by a peculiar problem a bizarre ice cream van that literally gives out brain freezes But these arent your typical chilly headaches they bring about strange, hilarious, and sometimes even spooky consequences. As Sam tries to uncover the truth behind this peculiar phenomenon, he finds himself embroiled in an unforgettable and uproarious adventure. Ideal for middlegrade readers aged 812, Brain Freeze is packed with Tom Fletchers signature blend of humor, lighthearted mystery, and imaginative storytelling. It serves as a fantastic standalone read and also offers a fun glimpse into the weird and wonderful world of The Creakers. This captivating short story is a perfect choice for kids looking for a quick, entertaining escape, making it a musthave for any young readers collection looking for a dose of adventure and laughs.

name: pachis prativa vag 6
description: Pachis Prativa Vag 6 invites readers to delve into a world of inspiration and achievement. As the sixth compelling installment in the acclaimed Pachis Prativa nonfiction series, this book meticulously compiles short, insightful biographies of 25 diverse and influential personalities. From visionary leaders and pioneering scientists to celebrated artists and dedicated social reformers, each profile offers a fascinating glimpse into their extraordinary journeys, highlighting their challenges, triumphs, and the lasting contributions theyve made to the world. name: Himalaya Alpine-Style ヒマラヤアルパイン・スタイル
description: Dive into the exhilarating world of highaltitude adventure with Himalaya AlpineStyle , a compelling mountaineering book that explores the pinnacle of climbing achievement. Published by the esteemed YamaKei, this meticulously crafted volume delves into the demanding yet purist ethos of alpinestyle climbing in the majestic Himalayan mountains. It highlights expeditions where climbers ascend the worlds highest peaks with minimal gear, no fixed ropes, and selfsufficiency, embodying a profound connection with the unyielding mountains. This essential addition to any mountaineering enthusiasts library compiles thrilling narratives, strategic insights, and philosophical reflections from pioneering climbers who have pushed the boundaries of human endurance on uncharted or incredibly challenging routes. Readers will gain a deep understanding of the immense physical and mental fortitude required for highaltitude expeditions, as well as the unique strategies employed to achieve audacious goals in the planets most formidable terrain. More than just a collection of ascents, Himalaya AlpineStyle examines the very essence of how brave climbers confront the natural grandeur and dangers of the Himalaya. Discover the true spirit of alpine heroism and the extraordinary feats that define modern climbing history.

name: Das Duell
description: Enter the relentless and chilling world of Das Duell , a masterful psychological thriller by the acclaimed author Richard Matheson. Originally a gripping novella, this classic work of fiction plunges an ordinary man into an extraordinary nightmare, transforming a routine road trip into a desperate fight for survival against an unseen, terrifying force. The story follows David Mann, a travelling salesman, whose serene journey on a desolate desert highway shatters when he inadvertently provokes a menacing, rustcolored tanker truck. What begins as a petty road rage incident escalates into a terrifying catandmouse chase, as the monstrous truck and its anonymous driver relentlessly pursue Mann, pushing him to the brink of his sanity. Matheson masterfully builds unbearable tension, forcing the protagonist, and the reader, to confront profound questions about vulnerability, modern terror, and the nature of an inexplicable threat. Das Duell is a seminal piece of suspense literature, renowned for its visceral thrill and its profound exploration of existential dread. Its enduring power is best evidenced by its iconic adaptation into Steven Spielbergs acclaimed debut feature film. Perfect for readers who appreciate intense, characterdriven thrillers and the subtle psychological horror crafted by literary giants, this short yet incredibly potent novel offers an unforgettable journey into the heart of paranoia and the chilling vulnerability of everyday life.

name: Ponies at the Point

Part of the popular Pony Camp Diaries series, this charming story follows Vicky and her spirited mare, Pip, as they embark on an unforgettable summer at Pony Camp. From the moment they arrive, Vicky is determined to make progress with her sometimesmischievous pony, but the challenges are plentiful, not least from her rival, the competitive Charlotte. Perfect for young readers who dream of ponies and outdoor escapades, Ponies at the Point is a heartwarming tale of friendship, overcoming obstacles, and the unique bond between a girl and her horse. This engaging novel blends exciting pony adventures with relatable themes of rivalry and growing up, making it a great choice for aspiring equestrians and anyone who loves a good summer story. Dive into this classic pony fiction and experience the joy and spirit of Pony Camp

name: Bataima Thaili

Add Bataima Thaili to your library and discover why Jhamak Ghimires voice resonates so powerfully across the literary landscape.

name: The Very Best of Arabian Nights
description: Embark on a mesmerizing journey into a world of magic, adventure, and timeless wisdom with The Very Best of Arabian Nights. This captivating collection brings together the most beloved and enchanting tales from the legendary One Thousand and One Nights, a cornerstone of Middle Eastern literature. At its heart lies the formidable challenge faced by the clever Scheherazade, who must weave a new, intriguing story each night to save her own life, charming the vengeful Sultan Shahryar with her unparalleled storytelling prowess. name: The Matlock Paper
description: Dive into the pulsepounding world of international espionage and intricate conspiracy with The Matlock Paper, a classic spy thriller by the master of the genre, Robert Ludlum. Here, readers are introduced to James Barbour Matlock, a brilliant but unconventional English professor whose quiet academic life is shattered when hes offered a seemingly innocuous assignment to investigate drug trafficking at his prestigious New England university. What begins as a straightforward task quickly spirals into a labyrinthine plot that pulls him into a vast, shadowy organization with farreaching global tentacles. As Matlock digs deeper, he unearths a shocking network of power, betrayal, and violence, discovering that the conspiracys roots stretch back to the Vietnam War and involve figures at the highest levels of government and society. With his own life now in peril and implicated in the very crimes hes investigating, Matlock must fight not only to expose the truth but also to clear his name. Ludlum meticulously crafts a narrative filled with his signature blend of breakneck pacing, intricate plotting, and unexpected twists, keeping readers on the edge of their seats from the first page to the last. The Matlock Paper is a quintessential Ludlum novel, offering a thrilling journey into the murky depths of covert operations and moral dilemmas. Perfect for fans of gripping action, complex political intrigue, and unforgettable characters, this bestselling book solidifies Ludlums legacy as a pioneer of the modern thriller. Prepare for a suspenseful read that questions who you can trust and how far one man will go to seek justice.

name: Unter der Haut
description: Dive into the chilling depths of human despair and intricate deception with Unter der Haut , the seventh captivating instalment in Jussi AdlerOlsens globally bestselling Department Q series. When a series of seemingly unrelated disappearances and a hitandrun death of a social worker lead to dead ends, an aging, desperate former client approaches Department Q, convinced the police have missed vital clues. As Assad, Rose, and Carl dig deeper, they uncover a disturbing pattern connecting fragile young women, manipulative figures, and a sinister, almost cultlike network preying on societys most vulnerable. The investigation takes a personal toll, particularly on Rose, whose own mental state begins to unravel under the pressure, adding a profound layer of psychological suspense to the already gripping narrative. AdlerOlsen masterfully weaves a tale of social commentary, dark secrets, and relentless tension. Unter der Haut is a meticulously plotted crime fiction novel that explores themes of loneliness, mental health crises, and the disturbing lengths to which individuals can be driven. Perfect for fans of Scandinavian thrillers and intricate police procedurals, this book promises a richly atmospheric and deeply unsettling reading experience that keeps you guessing until the very last page.

name: The Bourne Supremacy
description: Dive back into the electrifying world of international espionage with The Bourne Supremacy, another masterfully crafted spy thriller by bestselling author Robert Ludlum. This gripping novel continues the saga of Jason Bourne, the CIAs most dangerous former assassin, as he struggles to leave his violent past behind and live a quiet life as a university professor. However, Bournes fragile peace is shattered when a ruthless, highly skilled professional killer emerges, an enigmatic figure known only as Gou Shou or The Hand of God. This new assassin is meticulously framing Bourne for a series of highprofile political assassinations across Asia, threatening to ignite a major international crisis and reignite the Cold War. As governments and intelligence agencies worldwide, including the CIA and Chinese intelligence, hunt him down, Bourne must emerge from the shadows. From the bustling streets of Hong Kong to the clandestine corridors of power, Bourne races against time to unmask his doppelgnger and expose the vast, chilling conspiracy behind him. Ludlum weaves an intricate plot filled with pulsepounding action, psychological tension, and shocking betrayals, forcing Bourne to confront his own identity and the legacy of Treadstone. The Bourne Supremacy is an essential read for fans of intricate espionage novels and intense, highstakes thrillers that keep you on the edge of your seat until the very last page.

name: kumari
description: Immerse yourself in a deeply moving and culturally rich narrative with Kumari The Living Goddess, a poignant novel by acclaimed Nepali author Manjushree Thapa. Thapa masterfully portrays Devis remarkable journey,her sacred enthronement to the inevitable moment of her dethronement upon reaching puberty. The narrative then shifts to Devis profound struggle to reintegrate into a secular existence in her remote mountain village, a world she is utterly unprepared for. As Devi navigates the complexities of an ordinary life, this thoughtprovoking literary work explores universal themes of identity, freedom, innocence lost, and the compelling clash between ancient traditions and modern realities. Translated by Michael Hutt, Kumari offers a powerful and insightful look into Nepalese society and the personal cost of divine duty. Its a mustread for anyone seeking a unique and immersive cultural fiction experience, perfect for readers who appreciate richly drawn characters and narratives that explore the human spirit against a vibrant, traditional backdrop.

Dork Diaries Frenemies Forever is an ideal choice for young readers aged 812 who enjoy relatable stories about school, friendship drama, and finding your place. Join Nikki Maxwell on another unforgettable journey filled with humour, unexpected twists, and plenty of trademark dorky charm.

name: Democracy without Roots
description: Dive deep into the complex political landscape of Nepal with Democracy without Roots by acclaimed author Hari Bansh Jha. This insightful and critical political analysis examines the persistent challenges and inherent fragilities of democratic governance in Nepal. The book meticulously explores historical transitions, institutional weaknesses, and the sociopolitical factors that have prevented democracy from taking deep, sustainable roots in the country. Through compelling arguments and detailed observations, Jha uncovers the underlying reasons for political instability, widespread corruption, and the struggle to establish effective governance in the Himalayan nation. Democracy without Roots is an essential read for anyone seeking to understand Nepals contemporary political journey, offering valuable perspectives on its unique developmental trajectory. Ideal for students, scholars, policymakers, and general readers interested in South Asian politics, this thoughtprovoking book provides a comprehensive framework to comprehend the intricacies of Nepals democratic experience. It is a musthave for anyone looking for a rigorous, wellresearched exploration of political science and governance in the region.

name: So many questions
description: Dive into a journey of selfdiscovery and introspection with So Many Questions by acclaimed Nepali author and motivational speaker, Bibek Ojha. This compelling nonfiction book serves as a guiding companion for readers grappling with lifes big questions, career uncertainties, personal challenges, and the continuous pursuit of purpose and success. Written by an experienced school principal with a deep understanding of multicultural classrooms, this insightful work offers a pragmatic and often provocative perspective on the challenges and solutions surrounding linguistic integration in a diverse society. Baur argues passionately for the critical importance of early German language learning, beginning in kindergarten, as a cornerstone for educational success and full participation in society. Drawing on his extensive personal experience in Berlins diverse districts, he provides vivid examples and tackles the complex interplay of cultural differences, parental involvement, and the crucial role of the German education system. Far from merely stating problems, this social commentary presents concrete proposals and calls for a decisive shift in approach, urging parents, educators, and policymakers to prioritize language development to foster true equality of opportunity for all children. name: Kehi Gadbad
description: Dive into the candid and captivating world of Nepali cinema and comedy with Kehi Gadbad, the poignant autobiography of legendary artist Madan Krishna Shrestha. name: Black Beauty
description: Dive into the poignant world of Black Beauty, Anna Sewells enduring and beloved classic novel, uniquely told from the perspective of a sensitive and observant horse. This timeless tale chronicles the full life journey of Black Beauty, from his carefree days as a colt in a peaceful meadow to his demanding experiences with a diverse range of owners, encompassing both heartwarming kindness and harsh cruelty. More than just an animal story, Black Beauty serves as a powerful and empathetic commentary on animal welfare and the importance of compassionate treatment. Sewells work, originally published in 1877, became an immediate bestseller and a foundational text in advocating for humane treatment of horses during the Victorian era. Its captivating narrative and compelling characters continue to resonate with readers of all ages, making it a perfect classic novel for both young readers discovering the joys of classic literature and adults seeking a moving and meaningful story. Discover why this heartwarming and influential book remains a cherished family read and a testament to the power of kindness and resilience.

name: The state and society in Nepal

Authored by a leading scholarly voice on Nepal, the book traces the historical trajectory of power, administration, and societal development, exploring key themes such as land reform, economic policies, political transitions, and the constant negotiation between official structures and local realities. Readers will gain a deeper understanding of how the Nepali state has functioned, its challenges in fostering inclusive development, and the impact of its policies on diverse communities across the country. An essential resource for academics, researchers, students of South Asian studies, political science, history, and anyone with a keen interest in Nepals unique political and social landscape, The State and Society in Nepal stands as a foundational text. It offers an invaluable analytical framework for comprehending the historical underpinnings and contemporary challenges facing the Himalayan nation, making it a mustread for comprehensive insights into Nepali society and governance.

name: Vicious Vikings
description: Dive into the dark and often disgusting world of the Vicious Vikings, another brilliantly gruesome instalment in the awardwinning Horrible Histories series by Terry Deary. Youll learn about their surprisingly hygienic habits, their unique laws, and their eventual demise, all presented with Terry Dearys signature blend of macabre humor and meticulous research. Packed with foul facts, terrible tales, fantastic quizzes, and hilarious illustrations by Martin Brown, this engaging history book makes learning about the past an unforgettable adventure. This captivating story unfolds entirely through the eyes of a sentient family home in Nepal, inviting readers to witness the joys, sorrows, and profound changes that shape the lives of two sisters growing up within its walls. As the house itself narrates, it intimately chronicles the sisters journey from childhood dreams and youthful exuberance to the complexities of adolescence, love, marriage, and lifes inevitable challenges. This beautifully crafted Nepali novel exquisitely captures the essence of family bonds and the enduring power of sisterhood, providing a window into the daily life and cultural nuances of Nepal. Readers who appreciate characterdriven stories and a fresh approach to storytelling will find themselves deeply moved by this insightful and compelling tale. Our Beautiful House celebrates the timeless connection between a family and the place they call home, making it a mustread for anyone seeking a unique and emotionally resonant literary experience.

name: Bhyagutaka Sathiharu

In Nepalese life and culture, the monsoon is a period of immense significance, shaping landscapes, livelihoods, and the very fabric of daily existence. Dhurba Krishna Deep, a notable voice in Nepalese literature, skillfully weaves a story that is likely steeped in themes of human resilience, the intricate relationship between nature and human experience, and the cyclical rhythm of life. Readers can expect to discover deeply personal journeys set against the backdrop of this crucial season, revealing struggles, adaptations, and moments of profound beauty. An essential read for anyone interested in German history, World War II, the Nazi resistance, and the inspiring stories of courageous women in history, Leni Behrendt provides a poignant and detailed portrait of a woman who risked everything for her beliefs. This historical biography is a valuable addition for students, scholars, and general readers alike, offering profound insights into the nature of resistance and the enduring power of individual conviction in the face of tyranny.
